analysis.summary: Mediators are urging the United States and Iran to reach a deal to end the ongoing war in the Middle East. President Trump is reportedly weighing military strikes as early as this week. Trump has said the war will quickly conclude after the midterm elections on Tuesday, though he has not clearly explained how that would happen.
